# Asbily Tools

> Free Tools. Simple Solutions. Local-first browser utilities published by Asbily Platforms at https://tools.asbily.com.

## Overview
- Publisher: Asbily Platforms (https://asbily.com)
- Product URL: https://tools.asbily.com
- Total Utilities: 111 browser-native tools across 15 categories
- Privacy Model: 100% local client-side processing via HTML5 Canvas, Web Crypto, File APIs, Three.js WebGL, jsPDF, and pdf-lib. No user files or inputs are sent to remote servers.
- Offline Support: Installable PWA; works offline for compatible tools once cached on initial online load.
